title: Eosinophil–neutrophil context and CRP prediction: an exploratory independent-cycle test
abstract: Eosinophil–neutrophil interaction changed independent-cycle log-CRP prediction MSE by 0.000187 (baseline minus interaction; two-sample PSU-refit 95% interval [-0.002149, 0.001810]); no reliable improvement is demonstrated. Exploratory transfer, not clinical validation.
